name: Retrieval Fulfilment Initiation V 04
definition: The RetrievaFulfilmentInitiation message is sent by an acquirer or agent to an issuer to support an issuer's retrieval request.||The RetrievaFulfilmentInitiation message is the activity initiated by the acceptor, the acquirer or the relevant agent to support the issuer who has determined that a transaction information document needs to be examined before a potential chargeback is sent or to satisfy another need of the issuer or the cardholder. Only an issuer or its agent can initiate a retrieval request.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Information related to the protocol management.

TransactionCharacteristics.name: Transaction Characteristics
TransactionCharacteristics.definition: Contains the key data elements of the transaction.

Sender.name: Sender
Sender.definition: Party sending the message to another intermediary agent or to the final destination.

Card.name: Card
Card.definition: Card or payment token performing the transaction.

Programme.name: Programme
Programme.definition: Programme, network, or brand processes the transaction.

ConversionDateTime.name: Conversion Date Time
ConversionDateTime.definition: Date and Time of currency conversion.

Acceptor.name: Acceptor
Acceptor.definition: Card acceptor performing the card transaction.

Transactor.name: Transactor
Transactor.definition: Information related to the transactior who provides technical payment solutions for acceptor and originator to conduct transactions.

Terminal.name: Terminal
Terminal.definition: Payment terminal or ATM performing the transaction.

Payer.name: Payer
Payer.definition: The party providing source of funds.

Wallet.name: Wallet

SpecialProgrammeQualification.name: Special Programme Qualification

Jurisdiction.name: Jurisdiction

SettlementService.name: Settlement Service

AdditionalFee.name: Additional Fee

Reconciliation.name: Reconciliation

OriginalTransaction.name: Original Transaction

RetrievalFulfilmentInstructions.name: Retrieval Fulfilment Instructions

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
